description: Microsoft 365 hooks: a permissionDecision 'ask' gate on the outward-facing writes (send an email draft, create a calendar event with invitations, send a Teams message, delete a message, create a sharing link). The list lives in data/tools.json under 'confirm'; a test keeps this matcher in step with it.

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/pre_write_confirm.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
